fusions.name: Sudden Crack
fusions.desc: Fires a hardened shard of reef that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, always strikes critically, and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scattergrit
fusions.desc: Looses 5 shards of broken reef at once in a wide spread, each dealing 6 damage and knocking the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Spotter Polyps
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further. A line of polyps fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Answering Shell
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
